answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the spiral of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the ridge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the umber of the next round. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, weighted by independent path length, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
